description: Meet Calico Melton, a Bristol artist creating whimsical narrative pieces or abstract imagery, but always in my signature elevated colour palette and textural mark marking. Original artwork for interiors.
title: Hello, I'm Calico
lede: I'm a painter in Bristol. I am a mum, a maker, an artist and illustrator.
studioHeading: I create whimsical, original artwork for your walls,!
studioText: Each piece is created from imaginary worlds, conjured from a lifelong interest in folk art, vintage animation and children's books. Pieces are depicted as both whimsical narrative pieces or abstract imagery, but always in my signature elevated colour palette and textural mark marking.
body:
## How I work

Using acrylic, oil, canvas as well as textiles I conjure images purely from my imagination, to bring original art to your walls, designed to bring some joy and uniqueness to your home.
